### What I changed
I fixed the [PieceDiffComponent](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs:5473:0-5562:1) plane mapping compile issue by disambiguating [Plane](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs:2139:0-2165:1) to Rhino’s type in the two affected spots:

- Local variables in [GetModelData](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs:7205:4-7242:5) now use [Rhino.Geometry.Plane](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs:2139:0-2165:1)  
  @compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs#5518-5524
- Fallback values in [SetModelData](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs:7244:4-7268:5) now use `Rhino.Geometry.Plane.Unset`  
  @compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs#5551-5557

### Why
The refactor introduced [Plane](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs:2139:0-2165:1) references that resolved to [Compose.Plane](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs:2139:0-2165:1) in this scope, but `WorldXY`/`Unset` and `DA.GetData` here require Rhino plane values. Using fully-qualified [Rhino.Geometry.Plane](file:///workspaces/semio/compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs:2139:0-2165:1) removes the ambiguity and fixes the type mismatch.
